title: --defense's 'no unpiloted tower kill' bisects to d0a7e640 (ground events in SAT-3's feed instead of the camera cut): under the feed the breach's crowd wanders at its sinkhole and never walks to the Rotor; &cuts=dive on the same build walks and kills; the feed's render pass, the reveal pose and the handler's gates are not it. And --story was never a regression: its landmark counts were stale since 2026-09-14 (fixed)
context: Owner, 2026-10-14: 'bisect the pearl-enemies commits for the --defense and --story reds' (the two reds the refactor round 2 review found on the base 8bf59188, 2026-10-14-refactor-round-2-architecture-review). Method: two detached worktrees, the good end run first, git bisect run over 7d71f381..8bf59188 with node scripts/browser-test.mjs on its own STALHEART_BROWSER_PORT (18155 collides when two suites start together). --defense: green at 7d71f381; good ec4c92d3, f2367e17, 459afa0f; bad 29434e00, 5d19c38b, d0a7e640; first bad d0a7e640 'Ground events in SAT-3's orbital feed instead of a camera cut' (src/fx/ground-feed.js; td-tab calls groundFeed.dive where startDiveShot ran unless &cuts=dive, groundFeed.render each frame, the reveal's poseAt the gameplay pose; back-door the same swap). The step: commitTower('rotor', story.socket), spawnFodder(20) (a breach at gunshipRig.far() when no source is alive), 120 s for killsBySrc.tower to rise. --story: red at 7d71f381 and at the 2026-10-07 review commit d421da6c with the same '15 !== 12'; the review entry never names --story. Its assertion (62fdceee, 2026-09-14) predates 1773d933 (same day, the expedition rules: rocket-c, rocket-d, wreck-b at stage 1), and the next two counts (9 far tiers, 5 at stage 1) were stale the same way.
outcome: --story: not a regression; its three landmark counts re-based to the content (15 at stage 8, 12 far tiers, 8 at stage 1; commit 7cb64553 on pearl-enemies) and the suite runs green end to end at the pearl tip. --defense: a regression of d0a7e640, left for the owner (the feed is his design, a day old). What the harness showed, polled every 10 s through the 120 s wait at 8bf59188+: feed path: 197 records alive, every one 0.4-0.5 chord from the parked hull for the whole wait, their cur/next cells flipping among a few neighbours (wandering), frozen false, no shot active, the feed closed after 12 s, kills 0/0/0. Dive path (&cuts=dive, same build): 217 alive (twenty more, the fodder), the crowd closing 0.4 -> 0.3 -> 0.2, the first tower kill by 60 s, all twelve steps green. Ruled out on the feed path, each red the same way: the feed's render pass removed, the reveal's poseAt put back to the orbit frame, the breach handler's old gates (!shotActive && !pilotMode && !gunship && !seated && !danger) restored around groundFeed.dive. Left to look at: why the crowd under the feed has no route (the wall cells breached by the group's open callback and recomputePortalDist run in both paths; the twenty missing records say spawnFodder's breach or spawn goes differently when no dive shot runs; src/fx/back-door.js's swap is the other diveCuts branch). The owner can repeat it: ?sw=0&acceptance=1&cine=0&world=story&stage=6&phase=expedition#td, then the harness calls above; &cuts=dive is the control.
alternatives: Fix the feed path in this session: the feed is the owner's direction of 2026-10-13 and the cause is not pinned; a guess would be redone.
Mark --defense as a known red: it was green at 7d71f381 three days earlier and a real crowd not reaching the base is a game bug, not a suite rot.
evidence: the bisect runner and logs in the session scratchpad bisect/defense (summary.log with the git bisect log, <sha>.log per step), bisect/story-15*.log (the --story suite green after the three counts), defdiag/{feed,dive,poll,e1..e5}.log (the polled runs)
